verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payment automation, plus automated GL coding by entity via its Bill Pay/AP product and Payments/Accounting APIs, which covers coding and payment routing. However, no evidence explicitly describes matching invoices to purchase orders (3-way match), only general 'AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments' and GL coding claims. Missing for 10: explicit PO-to-invoice matching capability, documentation or examples of PO reconciliation, and independent/hands-on verification of the AP automation workflow's accuracy.
